title: Automattic has a new board after failed attempt to put CEO on leave | TechCrunch
summary: Following the failed board vote, member Toni Schneider, a founding CEO of Automattic and now CEO of Bluesky, resigned from his board position. Ann Dunwoody from the board, and board member Sue Decker also resigned.
